query: WITH h AS (INSERT INTO intake.homeowner (contact_id, created_at) VALUES ($1, now()) RETURNING id), c AS (INSERT INTO intake.conversation (homeowner_id, language, first_inbox_id, consent_template, consent_sent_at, opened_at) SELECT id, 'en', gen_random_uuid(), 'consent_first', now(), now() FROM h RETURNING id, homeowner_id), r AS (INSERT INTO intake.consent_record (homeowner_id, conversation_id, channel, inbox_id, consent_version, consented_at) SELECT homeowner_id, id, 'sms', gen_random_uuid(), $2, now() FROM c RETURNING id) INSERT INTO messaging.outbox (idempotency_key, template_id, recipient_id, recipient_kind, subject_ids, body) SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(gen_random_uuid()::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), 'fake.notice', $1, 'homeowner', ARRAY[]::uuid[], $3 FROM r
